# Streamlit Phase Calibration Key Fix

Date: 2026-01-07

## Summary
Fixed a Streamlit session_state mutation error when clicking “Calibrate Phases” in the MMI demo. Calibrated phases (and n_core when applicable) are now staged for the next run and applied before widgets are instantiated, avoiding Streamlit’s key update restriction.

## Files Modified
- `examples/14_mmi_streamlit.py`
  - Phase and n_core calibration now store updates in `session_state` and trigger `st.experimental_rerun()`.
  - Pending `phase_updates` are applied before sliders are created on the next render.

## Notes
- Behavior unchanged for users; the error `st.session_state.phase_0 cannot be modified after the widget with key phase_0 is instantiated` is resolved.
- No tests run (UI-only change); manual verification recommended via `streamlit run examples/14_mmi_streamlit.py` and pressing “Calibrate Phases.”
